paper.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
paper.central_claim: Active Task-Driving Memory represents task data and its evolving execution status rather than passive records; verifier-gated SFT plus memory-ON/OFF, cost-aware STR-GRPO learn selective useful memory use, yielding state-of-the-art online mobile performance and improved data-scope control on a scalable controlled benchmark. Original broad superiority, generalization and utility claims are retained here, not replaced with the narrower conclusion below.

retention_audit.selection_data_rule: Verifier-pass SFT traces; terminal-success-minus-active-memory penalty gives RL group advantages.
retention_audit.accepted_rejected: SFT failures rejected; RL samples weighted by advantages, not discrete deployable modifications selected on holdout.
retention_audit.persisted_artifact: Policy weights; episode memory is transient.
retention_audit.later_tasks: Reported AW/MW/DataScope evaluation; MobileWorld described as unseen environments.
retention_audit.independent_gain: Point-estimate recipe difference +1.8/+2.6SR versus GRPO, without independent repeats or separated penalty/intervention effects.
retention_audit.retained_improvement_claim: Ordinary learned-policy retention, not demonstrated cross-task episodic-memory improvement or recursive improver improvement.

gap.author_gap: Passive records leave item ownership, eligibility and completion implicit; long-horizon data workflows require active status tracking.
gap.checked_gap: Specific item-level bookkeeping is a meaningful residual. Universal passive-memory framing is too broad: AWM already stores workflows to drive subsequent decisions; AndroidWorld already composes executable tasks and partial rewards; MAI-UI already uses SFT+RL.

lineage/closest_adjacent.relation: Earlier workflow conditioning, distinct from mutable within-episode execution ledger.
Executable state checking, seeded/composite tasks and partial credit predecessor.
Same-scale mobile SFT/RL frontier and richer-action MW comparator.

gap.residue: Train explicit eligibility/status bookkeeping and selective invocation, stress-test scope rather than claim all memory was passive.
gap.stakes: Wrong recipients/records or duplicate writes create harmful side effects, not just longer traces.
gap.method_response: Structured item+phase state, terminal-verified SFT, same-initialization ON/OFF training and scope-aware checker construction.
gap.remaining_gap: Need aggregate same-policy representation/field removal, intervention-vs-cost factorial controls, independent checker audit, strict app/template separation, repeats and real deployment accounting.

condition_checks.reason: ON/OFF intervention during training; no full same-policy field/representation removal.
condition_checks.condition_name: Each role removed with the same backbone
condition_checks.condition_definition: The paper ablates the progress-summary/planning agent, memory unit, manager or reflector by removing it and reports the drop (SR 88.6 -> 59.1 without the planning agent; instruction SR 56% -> 12% without the manager hub or the reflection agent; subtask SR 76.0 -> 48.1) (2406.01014#s1, 2502.14282#s2, 2502.14282#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Not a recent-screenshot window compression method.
condition_checks.condition_name: Recent steps at full fidelity, older steps as text, with the window ablated
condition_checks.condition_definition: A few recent screenshots are kept verbatim and older history becomes action text or summaries, with the number of screenshots / history level ablated (three recent screenshots plus L1 action text beats one; L2 text history adds nothing) (2508.09123#s4, 2406.01014#s1).

condition_checks.reason: harvest/execute progress drives action; no explicit plan-tree pruning.
condition_checks.condition_name: Proactive replanning or prunable plan trees
condition_checks.condition_definition: The manager replans after every subgoal rather than only on failure (+4.62 / +6.15 points), or the agent maintains a plan tree it can branch and prune (WebArena SR 38.2% -> 43.1%) (2504.00906#s2, 2410.13825#s5).

condition_checks.reason: Screen-based operation success required, but not independently checked each step.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Post-action reflection compares before/after observations in settings where errors show as screen non-change or a recognisably wrong page and are reversible; guidelines plus a post-action success/failure summary lift M3A 19.8% -> 30.6% on AndroidWorld (2401.16158#s3, 2406.01014#s3, 2405.14573#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Not a manager-worker hierarchy contribution.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Separating planning from action decisions is reported across several backbones (Mobile-Agent-E 75.1 vs 53.0 satisfaction across three backbones) (2501.11733#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Retained relevant content and SR are reported; no aggregate matched step/cost attribution.
condition_checks.condition_name: Agent-nominated retained content with step savings
condition_checks.condition_definition: The agent lists pivotal element ids or focus content to keep, and the paper reports both success and steps (WebArena SR 37.1% -> 38.2%, steps 12.0 -> 8.6; removing the focus memory: SR 88.6 -> 77.3) (2410.13825#s4, 2406.01014#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Item completion is self-declared; terminal verification does not prove per-step label accuracy.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Reflection accuracy is as low as 78.8%, executor self-checks and the supervising orchestrator hallucinate, and completion is self-declared without a checker (2406.01014#s3, 2508.03923#s3, 2411.10323#s2, 2312.13771#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Wrong structured memory can propagate; status accuracy not quantified.
condition_checks.condition_name: Summaries hide errors over long horizons
condition_checks.condition_definition: Summaries returning only the final state hide intermediate mistakes from the orchestrator, long-horizon tasks (>30-50 actions) still lose coherent context, and summary error propagation is not measured (2508.03923#s2, 2508.09123#s4, 2406.01014#s1).

condition_checks.reason: No decomposition into worker roles.
condition_checks.condition_definition: With a weaker backbone the full multi-agent framework falls below its single agent (Qwen2.5-VL) (2502.14282#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Recipe ablation exists; complete inference-cost isolation missing.
condition_checks.condition_name: No role-removal ablation and unreported per-step cost
condition_checks.condition_definition: Several systems give no role-removal ablation, so gains cannot be assigned to the hierarchy alone, while each role adds per-step cost (2501.11733#s1, 2402.07939#s1, 2402.07456#s4).

condition_checks.reason: Wrong writes/messages not guaranteed reversible.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Plausible-looking wrong pages and irreversible actions (sending messages) defeat screenshot-diff reflection; plan pruning resets only the agent's context, not the web state (2406.01014#s3, 2401.16158#s3, 2410.13825#s5).

condition_checks.reason: Explicit multi-entry suite and baselines, but low terminal SR and qualitative loop cases.
condition_checks.condition_name: Loop pathologies on small, baseline-free suites
condition_checks.condition_definition: Repeated actions to the step limit, early stopping triggered by an 'unachievable' hint, loops from caching actions but not outcomes, or retained content that hurts dense single-page tasks, evaluated on small benchmarks without baselines (2307.13854#s4, 2405.14573#s3, 2410.13825#s4, 2401.16158#s2).

matches.reason: C16 agent-retained focus content generalizes to structured item ledger; main card fixed-backbone prompted-loop assumption does not encompass the policy training itself.
matches.condition_note: Conditions are claim-appropriate check questions, not a counted scoring denominator. Risk denotes plausible unexcluded failure, not an observed event unless explicitly stated.

condition_checks.reason: Verifier-gated SFT precedes onlineRL.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Online RL starts from an SFT/offline-trained policy; ~1k online trajectories suffice on short AitW tasks (2406.11896#s1, 2411.02337#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Clipped on-policy update; no demonstrated replay/perplexity-band recipe.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Updates are KL-constrained to the previous-phase policy and replay successful trajectories within a perplexity band; tasks are curriculum-filtered for informativeness (2411.02337#s3, 2406.11896#s1).

condition_checks.reason: No first-error correction data contribution.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Training data corrects the first erroneous step and adds a recovery action after it; reflection data raises level-2 success 14.58% -> 23.61%, online reflection tuning 23.61% -> 34.72%, and DPO on corrected vs erroneous actions improves OSWorld (72B 18.8 -> 22.7) (2506.08012#s1, 2506.08012#s2, 2501.12326#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Terminal-accepted trajectories, not action-matching thought filtering.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Generated per-step thoughts are kept only when the sampled action matches ground truth (bootstrapping), avoiding superficial rationalisation (2501.12326#s2, 2412.04454#s2).

condition_checks.reason: Training/evaluation are executable, not semi-online proxy.
condition_checks.condition_name: Offline proxy validated against online success
condition_checks.condition_definition: A semi-online/offline protocol is shown to correlate with online success (SOP vs AndroidWorld, R^2=0.934) (2509.11543#s3).

condition_checks.reason: No mixed reasoning-level contribution.
condition_checks.condition_name: Mixed reasoning levels with the decoding level ablated
condition_checks.condition_definition: Reasoning annotations synthesised by a strong MLLM are trained as a mixture of levels and the level used at decoding is ablated (mixing L1/L2/L3 and decoding L2: OSWorld 18.5% vs 13.1% L2-only; reflective long CoT 11.5% -> 15.3%) (2508.09123#s2, 2508.09123#s3, 2312.08914#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Long-phase stability and replay need not be inferred from clipped updates.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Without KL or replay, performance degrades over phases; replaying failures destabilises (2411.02337#s3).

condition_checks.reason: No expert exact-action mismatch reward.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Valid alternative actions are treated as mismatches and non-expert branches never see real next states (2509.11543#s1, 2509.11543#s3).

condition_checks.reason: Long-horizon cases and3 difficulty levels, but no benchmark run-to-run spread.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Evaluated on short tasks only, with few repeats and on subsets (WebArena-Lite) (2406.11896#s1, 2411.02337#s3).

condition_checks.reason: 4B/8B final models, detailed STR ablation8B only.
condition_checks.condition_name: Gains not shown across model sizes
condition_checks.condition_definition: Gains shrink with model size (2509.11543#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Task checker calibration exists; per-step memory correctness unvalidated.
condition_checks.condition_name: Unvalidated error labels and environment assumptions
condition_checks.condition_definition: MLLM verifier/first-error labels are not validated against humans, the method assumes Back restores the previous screen, and covers visual/grounding but not high-level planning errors; reflection tuning is not isolated by ablation (2506.08012#s1, 2506.08012#s2, 2501.12326#s1).

condition_checks.reason: Teacher reasoning noise not independently measured.
condition_checks.condition_definition: Single-sample system-2 decoding is worse in-domain (irrelevant/hallucinated reasoning); redundant actions in source trajectories yield wrong reasoning (7.8%); an observation-description (L3) level misleads at inference and self-correction is conjectured rather than isolated (2501.12326#s2, 2412.04454#s2, 2508.09123#s3, 2508.09123#s2).

matches.reason: Subcard null deliberately: K20 requires learned critics/mixed TD-MC and filtered replay, unlike group-relative STR-GRPO; other subcards concern different data edits.

condition_checks.condition_definition: Tasks (and generated sites) are produced from an evaluator library or shared spec, with a repair loop until task-relevant tests pass (removing it: 85.6 -> 82.6) (2510.17790#s2, 2601.04126#s1).

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Author-reported online MW execution on environments explicitly unseen during training meets the unseen-environment branch; only Android platform demonstrated, no cross-platform claim or independent replication.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Verifier-filtered SFT plus STR-GRPO yields reported Qwen3-VL8B online point estimates76.6AW/23.3MW, +1.8/+2.6 over ordinaryGRPO while fewer tasks invoke explicit memory. DataScope makes scope errors measurable, but its terminal success remains6.2/6.2/3.1. Broad SOTA, independent schema-causal attribution and deployment efficiency are not established.
unresolved: Independent run-to-run uncertainty and exact eval budget matching.
Prompt/prose schema equivalence, per-item update correctness and invalid-memory recovery.
Checker residual error, alternative valid results and train/spec overlaps.
Figure-only aggregate memory ablation numbers and graphic error-count labels not inspected; do not infer them from captions.
Table6 one-app CalendarMeetingPrepAndNotify conflicts with five-app Listing1.
Fixed MAI-UI frontier comparisons require exact same MW subset/protocol before numerical superiority comparisons.
assessment.retained_improvement: Training checkpoint retention, not independently isolated cross-task memory gain.

G.reason: Concrete item-identity/eligibility/completion gap with executable scope stress; lineage checked against AWM/AW/MAI. Universal passive-memory and full-frontier framing too broad for4.

M.reason: Explicit state interface, verifier gating and balanced-channel objective address bookkeeping and selective use. Reconstructible overall, but schema-lock/prose versus actual prompt, self-labeled status and coupled penalty/intervention keep assumptions below4.

X.reason: Execution prompt and generation prompt are now present in authoritative PDF; full operational loop, data selection and checker-repair chain described. Not penalized as missing prompts. Recovery, exact schema consistency and independent checker acceptance bounds remain incomplete.

E.measurement.reason: Online executable SR plus app/scope metrics and controlled checker calibration support meaningful measurement. Not4 because calibration shares generated spec, error rates/legal alternatives unaudited, and family metadata inconsistent.

E.causality.reason: Same-backbone SFT/GRPO/STR controls and training intervention are relevant; separate representation, cost coefficient and intervention factorials plus matched training compute not established.

E.holdout.reason: Explicit MW unseen-environment assertion and multiple suites provide some transfer evidence. Complete app/template construction separation is missing; unrestricted SOTA conflicts with broader fixed frontier rather than proving it.

review_sequence.A_fixed_facts: Identity/version/hash and full scientific source checked; broad central claim retained; 3 operational signatures; training or retention chain traced.
review_sequence.B_gap_and_patterns: Fixed nearest-source excerpts checked; original15+31 overviews and selected full originals read before matching; GUI taxonomy/conditions, matched full cards and applicable frozen expectations checked.

experiment_context.backbones: Qwen3-VL4B/8B trained into ATMem-UI. Detailed recipe comparison is8B; teacher planner+UIIns has different information, parameters and action machinery.
experiment_context.training_data: 20 real Android apps,120 human-designed verified templates,~1.2K candidates/~1.1K executable instances and21,713 terminal-accepted teacher SFT steps.
experiment_context.evaluation_environment: AndroidWorld, MobileWorld GUI navigation and DataScope96 instances in32families/14apps; MobileWorld environments described as unseen during training. Full app/version/template overlap not enumerated.
experiment_context.budget: 128 Android containers/H20 GPUs for training; appendix~2hSFT/~3daysRL and long response caps disclosed. No fully matched inference token/latency/dollar accounting, RL alpha sensitivity or independent budget parity.
experiment_context.selection_development_test: SFT acceptance by terminal verifier, STR ON/OFF groups from equal initializations. Checker calibration built from shared specs. No independent legal-implementation pool or complete app/template split registry.
experiment_context.metrics_and_denominators: SR is full terminal task success; DataScope32tasks/level with App-Prog andScope-F1. Table4Mem is fraction of tasks invoking memory at least once; trainingrho is fraction of memory-active steps. Uninspected plots are not numerical evidence.
experiment_context.statistics: Known DataScope task-family/level counts but no independent run variance/CI. Group reward standard deviation is not evaluation uncertainty.
experiment_context.alternative_explanations: Extra upstream SFT data, genericRL effects, coupled memory intervention and active-step penalty, compute, model scale and teacher privilege. Full structured-vs-flat/full-history/no-memory factorial not quantitatively established from available inspected text.
